items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: only my brother - Roger Kay and his girl friend Nancy, also the Normans and some of the others that lived in the house knew about it.

ctx.x: Oran "Hot Lips" Page taken an orchestra into the Apollo for one week and had asked me to join the band. I refused because I was expecting a word from Charles any day telling me that everything was set and I didn't want to be tied up in any circumstances.

On the 10th of December, I received a cable saying that a plane ticket was waiting for me at the Air France office..I was to leave the 12th. I could have made the Apollo gig for Lips but I didn't know things were going to happen the way they did. I did not have time to tell most of my friends that I was leaving but they knew I was expecting to leave. Even my girl friend Irene didn't know I was leaving so suddenly, and only my brother - Roger Kay and his girl friend Nancy, also the Normans and some of the others…

I bought a bottle of whisky, my brother came to the house and I was packing all night. I didn't realize I had so much this and that until then. I had told the Normans that I was going to Europe for 3 months, but I had decided that I was going to stay even if I had to drink muddy water and sleep in a hollow log. That's why I was taking everything I owned with me. But there was a surprise waiting for me when I arrived at the Air France office and terminus. I had $100.-- of excess baggage. I was under the impression…
